obligations: Include MIT copyright notice and permission notice in all copies or substantial portions of the Software
Include Apache-2.0 license text and NOTICE file if present for @browserbasehq/sdk and playwright dependencies
Retain copyright, patent, trademark, and attribution notices for Apache-2.0 dependencies
State changes made to Apache-2.0 licensed files
rationale: The stagehand-agent package.json declares 'license: MIT' but there is no LICENSE, COPYING, or NOTICE file in the repository (confirmed via local filesystem search, git ls-files, and GitHub API 404 on /license and /contents/LICENSE). The upstream Stagehand framework (browserbase/stagehand) uses MIT license (verified via GitHub API and raw file content). However, two key runtime dependencies have different licenses: @browserbasehq/sdk (Apache-2.0 per npm registry) and playwright (Apache-2.0 per npm registry and GitHub API). The agent code transitively depends on these Apache-2.0 licensed packages. Since the repository declares MIT but contains no license file and has Apache-2.0 transitive dependencies requiring additional obligations (NOTICE file handling, patent grant, state changes), human legal review is required to confirm compatibility and compliance. The MIT declaration in package.json may reflect author intent but is not backed by a license file in the repo.
